name: Music Quality Radar（音乐质量雷达）
title_zh: 同一首歌，先听出它被压到几成再决定要不要换源
tagline_zh: 流媒体音质参差，耳朵又听不出门道。它用频谱分析把压缩痕迹摊开给你看，告诉你这首歌实际还剩多少细节。
tagline_en: Streaming quality varies, but ears deceive. This skill visualizes compression artifacts via spectrum analysis.
why_zh: 不靠玄学听感，直接看频谱图上的截止频率和量化噪声，用客观数据量化音质损失，让你在音质对比上有据可依。
why_en: No audiophile voodoo—just hard numbers from spectral cutoffs and quantization noise, turning subjective quality debates into.
limit_zh: 只分析本地音频文件，不处理流媒体在线播放；对已失真的音源只能检测无法修复；需具备基础频谱图阅读能力，否则看不懂输出结论。
limit_en: Analyzes local audio files only, not live streams. Detects but cannot restore lost quality. Requires basic spectrogram literacy to interpret results.
title_en: See how compressed your music really is before judging the.
